description: This is an XML configuration file defining a simple method called 'getOrder' within the OFBiz framework. The method is designed to retrieve order-related data for specific weeks within a year, optionally filtered by store ID. It contains logic for calculating week offsets and applying various entity conditions for querying sales order items.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves order data filtered by week and optionally by store, with date calculations and conditional entity-based filtering.
